controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T08:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T12:00:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY message
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20
